data.body:
[P2] Bind retained evidence to every declared cohort role

`load_manifest()` permits additional distinct roles, but offline validation never compares `selectedRequests` with the admitted role set. A native-overlap manifest declaring `victim`, `peer`, and another role can therefore pass using the ordinary two-request evidence, even though the additional role never ran. Live validation rejects this through `_ownership_errors`. Check declared/default role coverage in the shared identity validation and add a retained-evidence regression.
